reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it actively promotes OneCoin participation through claims that a split program can double a token portfolio in under ten weeks and urges viewers to register to secure their future. It also links bonuses to becoming a marketing partner and building a sales team, while encouraging viewers to offer contacts a way to profit, making recruitment-dependent earnings central to the solicitation. The video presents these financial and recruitment benefits as a limited opportunity rather than as neutral market commentary.

citations.quote: By becoming an active marketing partner of the ONE Network, and by popularizing ONE coin you will be able to qualify for exciting bonuses by building your own sales team.
The bonus plan lets you not only build a successful business, but gives you a chance to offer your contacts a way into profiting from the successful industry of cryptocurrency
The split program can double your tokens portfolio. Each portfolio has the chance to split up to two times. This means if you're active, you can increase your portfolio value in just under ten weeks.
Take your chance and register today. We are in our first launch phase and have a limited number of positions available during this phase
http://www.onecoin.eu/signup/OneCoinint

opening.argument: The presentation uses conditional and possibility-based language rather than promising a guaranteed outcome. It says viewers will have the “possibility” to profit after learning, and describes portfolio growth as something that can occur “if you're active.” Those qualifications leave room for market risk, user effort, and individual results. The material presents participation as an opportunity in an emerging field, not as a certain return: digital currencies are described as “the future of payments online,” while the viewer is invited to learn trading strategies and practice skills before exchanging tokens. On this record, the promotional tone does not by itself establish deceptive certainty.

citations.quote: These Tokens will give you the possibility for trading in on our Exchange with thousands of other members, practise your skills, and let you profit from what you have learned
This means if you're active, you can increase your portfolio value in just under ten weeks.
where you learn about trading strategies and how to profit from trading with cryptocurrency

rebuttal.rebuttal: The cited doubling statement is expressly conditional on being active, and the bonus passage describes a qualification process rather than an assured payment. “Take your chance” is opportunity language, not a guarantee. The registration appeal may be urgent, but urgency alone does not prove that the underlying opportunity is fraudulent or that every participant will receive a return.

citations.quote: This means if you're active, you can increase your portfolio value in just under ten weeks.
you will be able to qualify for exciting bonuses by building your own sales team.
Take your chance and register today.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Conditional wording does not neutralize the substance of the pitch. The video still says the split program “can double” a portfolio and links bonuses to building a sales team. Those are concrete financial inducements, while the cited language supplies no meaningful risk disclosure, loss scenario, or evidence supporting the expected value.

citations.quote: The split program can double your tokens portfolio.
you will be able to qualify for exciting bonuses by building your own sales team.
strong values connected to innovation and profitability for holders of the coin.

opening.argument: The central framing is educational and operational: viewers are told they will learn trading strategies, practice skills, follow business progress, and use an exchange. The presentation also explicitly identifies an “education program,” while the associated tokens are described as part of learning and practice. That is consistent with an introductory technology-and-trading presentation explaining how a proposed digital-currency ecosystem works. Its discussion of possible profit is part of explaining the use case, not proof that the video’s primary purpose is a deceptive solicitation.

citations.quote: OneCoin will be introduced through our education program
where you learn about trading strategies and how to profit from trading with cryptocurrency.
These Tokens will give you the possibility for trading in on our Exchange with thousands of other members, practise your skills

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling the material an education program does not make the financial pitch incidental. The same explanation says tokens can produce profit, portfolios can grow, and viewers should register. The educational framing is therefore part of the proposed commercial pathway, not neutral instruction detached from participation.

citations.quote: The ONE tokens can be exchanged once you feel proficient enough to start trading with cryptocurrency.
The split program can double your tokens portfolio.
Fill out our simple registration form

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The educational label does not explain away the recruitment and investment inducements. The program is presented alongside trading tokens, portfolio growth, bonuses, and registration. The cited education language shows the wrapper around the offer; it does not show an independent tutorial, tested demonstration, or balanced instruction about risks.

citations.quote: OneCoin will be introduced through our education program
By becoming an active marketing partner of the ONE Network, and by popularizing ONE coin you will be able to qualify for exciting bonuses by building your own sales team.
Take your chance and register today.

opening.argument: The supplied description is compatible with promotion of a bundled education and trading service: it mentions education packages, access to an exchange, a back-office portfolio, and practice tokens. The material does not specify a required deposit, request credentials, or document an actual payout. It describes a possible business opportunity and referral bonus, but the record does not establish that bonuses were paid, that contacts earned money, or that returns were guaranteed. Without those operational details, the evidence supports ordinary promotion of a proposed service more directly than a proven scam mechanism.

citations.quote: With our education packages you will receive free trading tokens
These Tokens will give you the possibility for trading in on our Exchange
Follow your tokens portfolio via the back-office
by popularizing ONE coin you will be able to qualify for exciting bonuses

rebuttal.rebuttal: The absence of a stated deposit or credential request is not decisive because the video expressly directs viewers to register and markets portfolio growth and team bonuses. Ordinary referral marketing can still be a recruitment-based financial scheme when earnings depend on building a sales team. The presentation itself supplies that dependency.

citations.quote: by popularizing ONE coin you will be able to qualify for exciting bonuses by building your own sales team.
Fill out our simple registration form, secure your future and join the One Network.
The split program can double your tokens portfolio.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The missing details do not cure the affirmative claims that are present. The video promotes portfolio doubling, a route to bonuses through a sales team, and registration framed as securing the viewer’s future. Whether a deposit or credential request appears is separate from whether the advertised earnings structure is recruitment-dependent and financially misleading.
